Supreme Court Upholds Bail Cancellation for Goa Nightclub Fire Accused

The Supreme Court on December 6, 2025, dismissed pleas challenging the Bombay High Court's order that set aside the bail granted to the accused in the Goa nightclub fire case. The fire, which occurred at the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Arpora, resulted in the deaths of 25 people and injured 50 others. The accused were given two weeks to surrender.
